title: The Miraculousness And Testimony Of The Quran 17th Degree The Impossibility Of Producing Its Like In View Of Source Addressee And Purpose

questions.question: What three things does the passage say help us judge how great a statement is?
questions.answer: We should know who said it, who it is meant for, and why it was said.

questions.question: Why does the passage say nothing can match the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Because it is from the Lord of all creation and has a greatness no human speech can reach.

questions.question: Who is described as the one receiving this message?
questions.answer: It is sent to the Prophet, peace be upon him, as the representative of all people and even all beings.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s faith?
questions.answer: It says his faith was very strong and very wide in meaning.

questions.question: What major result came from that strong faith?
questions.answer: It led to the rise of Islam in a mighty way.

questions.question: What kinds of matters does the Qur’an explain?
questions.answer: It explains matters about life in this world, the next life, creation, and Allah’s purposes in it.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the belief of the one addressed by the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It says his belief was the highest and broadest and carried the truths of Islam.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an show about the universe?
questions.answer: It shows the universe from every side and teaches about it clearly.

questions.question: Which examples are used to help us imagine how the Qur’an presents the universe?
questions.answer: It is compared to showing a map, a clock, or a house.

questions.question: In what way does the Qur’an teach about the universe?
questions.answer: It teaches about it in the way the Maker of it would explain it.

questions.question: According to the passage, can people produce something equal to the Qur’an? Why or why not?
questions.answer: No, because its miraculous level cannot be reached by people.

questions.question: What have many learned scholars done with the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They have written detailed explanations about it.

questions.question: How large does the passage say some of these commentaries are?
questions.answer: Some are thirty, forty, or even seventy volumes long.

questions.question: What do these scholars show through their studies?
questions.answer: They show many qualities, deep meanings, secrets, and signs found in the Qur’an.

questions.question: What special work is named in the passage as giving strong proofs about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: The Risale-i Nur is named as a work that proves many truths about it.

questions.question: What is the overall conclusion at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: The Qur’an has no equal, is a miracle, and is a true message from the Knower of the unseen.

questions.question: What makes the worth and beauty of speech clear, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Its speaker, its listener, and its purpose make its worth clear.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the source of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an comes from the Lord of all worlds and the Creator of everything.

questions.question: How is the Qur’an’s way of speaking described?
questions.answer: It is described as real and natural, not copied or fake.

questions.question: To whom is the Qur’an directed in this passage?
questions.answer: It is directed to the Messenger who stands for all human beings and all creatures.

questions.question: How is that Messenger described among people?
questions.answer: He is described as the most well-known and honored among mankind.

questions.question: What did the Messenger’s strong belief help bring into the world?
questions.answer: It helped bring forth the powerful religion of Islam.

questions.question: What subjects of happiness does the Qur’an discuss?
questions.answer: It teaches about happiness in this life and in the life to come.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an explain about creation?
questions.answer: It explains the results of creation and the purposes placed within the universe.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the faith of the one who received the Qur’an?
questions.answer: His faith was very high, very wide, and included the truths of Islam.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention a map, a clock, and a house?
questions.answer: They are examples to show that the Qur’an explains the universe in an organized and understandable way.

questions.question: Why is making something like the Qur’an said to be impossible?
questions.answer: Because it explains creation at a miraculous level that people cannot reach.

questions.question: What kind of people wrote explanations of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: Very careful, intelligent, and learned scholars wrote them.

questions.question: What do these explanations try to uncover in the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They uncover its many qualities, subtle points, hidden meanings, and signs about unseen matters.

questions.question: What is said about the parts of the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: Each part is said to prove one special feature or truth of the Qur’an.

questions.question: What kinds of things are mentioned as being discussed in some parts of the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: Some parts discuss the Qur’an’s miraculous style, signs related to inventions, meaningful wording, and news about unseen things.

questions.question: What final “stamp” or proof do all these studies give?
questions.answer: They confirm that the Qur’an is unmatched, miraculous, and a message from the unseen world.

questions.question: What does the opening sentence teach about understanding a message?
questions.answer: It teaches that we understand a message better when we know its source, audience, and goal.

questions.question: Based on that rule, why is the Qur’an shown as above all other speech?
questions.answer: Because its source, audience, and purpose are greater than any other speech.

questions.question: Who is named as the Speaker of the Qur’an?
questions.answer: The Speaker is the Lord and Creator of the whole universe.

questions.question: What does the passage mean when it says the Qur’an does not show imitation?
questions.answer: It means the Qur’an is original and not copied from anyone.

questions.question: Who receives the Qur’an on behalf of others?
questions.answer: The Prophet, peace be upon him, receives it on behalf of all people and all beings.

questions.question: What does the passage connect to the spread of Islam?
questions.answer: It connects the Prophet’s strong and wide faith to the rise of Islam.

questions.question: What two time periods of happiness are explained by the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It explains happiness for this world and for the Hereafter.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an teach about the universe besides its creation?
questions.answer: It also teaches the wisdom and purposes within it.

questions.question: How is the Prophet’s belief described compared with other belief?
questions.answer: It is described as the greatest and most comprehensive.

questions.question: What picture does the passage give of the Qur’an’s teaching about the universe?
questions.answer: It gives the picture of showing the whole universe clearly from every angle.

questions.question: Why is the Qur’an’s explanation of the universe special?
questions.answer: Because it explains it like the One who made it is teaching about it.

questions.question: What does the passage say many scholars have produced?
questions.answer: They produced many detailed commentaries on the Qur’an.

questions.question: What does the size of some commentaries suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests that the Qur’an has deep and rich meanings that take a lot to explain.

questions.question: What do the scholars use to support their explanations?
questions.answer: They use proofs and evidence.

questions.question: How does the passage present the Risale-i Nur’s role?
questions.answer: It presents it as a work that gives clear arguments for many truths and fine points of the Qur’an.

questions.question: What does the ending teach us about the Qur’an’s place?
questions.answer: It teaches that the Qur’an is unique, miraculous, and a true divine message.

questions.question: What basic rule about speech is given at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: A speech is understood by looking at its speaker, its listener, and its purpose.

questions.question: What conclusion does the passage draw about the Qur’an from that rule?
questions.answer: It concludes that no speech can be equal to it.

questions.question: What titles are used for the One from whom the Qur’an comes?
questions.answer: He is described as the Lord of all worlds and the Creator of the universe.

questions.question: How is the Qur’an different from ordinary human talk in this passage?
questions.answer: It is presented as pure and original, not made up or imitated.

questions.question: Who is the direct addressee of the Qur’an in the passage?
questions.answer: It is the Messenger sent in the name of all humanity and all beings.

questions.question: What honor is given to this Messenger among people?
questions.answer: He is described as the most famous and respected of human beings.

questions.question: What happened because of the strength of his faith?
questions.answer: A powerful Islam arose through it.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an explain about both lives?
questions.answer: It explains what leads to happiness in this life and the next.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur’an and the purpose of the universe?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an explains why the universe was created and the divine purposes in it.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the belief carried by the Messenger?
questions.answer: It says his belief held all the truths of Islam.

questions.question: What lesson is taught by comparing the universe to a map, clock, or house?
questions.answer: The lesson is that the Qur’an explains the universe in a complete and orderly way.

questions.question: Why can no one make a book equal to the Qur’an, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because its miraculous level is beyond human ability.

questions.question: What have thousands of scholars done to help people understand the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They have written large commentaries explaining its meanings and secrets.

questions.question: What kinds of things do these commentaries bring out?
questions.answer: They bring out deep meanings, fine details, special qualities, and signs about hidden matters.

questions.question: What is one main job of the Risale-i Nur in this passage?
questions.answer: Its job is to prove special truths and qualities of the Qur’an with strong arguments.

questions.question: What final truth do all these proofs point to?
questions.answer: They point to the truth that the Qur’an is unmatched and truly from Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, what do we need to know to understand the greatness of words?
questions.answer: We need to know who spoke them, who they were spoken to, and what they were meant to do.

questions.question: Why is the Qur’an presented as having no equal?
questions.answer: Because it comes from the Creator of everything and carries a purpose beyond human speech.

questions.question: What does the passage say about any sign of copying in the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It says there is no sign that it is copied or artificial.

questions.question: Who is the human receiver of the Qur’an in this passage?
questions.answer: The receiver is the Prophet, peace be upon him.

questions.question: In what role does he receive it?
questions.answer: He receives it in the name of all people and all beings.

questions.question: What effect did his strong belief have?
questions.answer: It helped establish a mighty Islam.

questions.question: What major topics does the Qur’an cover in the passage?
questions.answer: It covers happiness in both worlds, creation, the purpose of the universe, and the truths of faith.

questions.question: How is the Messenger’s faith described?
questions.answer: It is described as the highest and widest in scope.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an do with the universe, according to the passage?
questions.answer: It turns toward it from every side and explains it fully.

questions.question: Why are the examples of a map, clock, and house helpful?
questions.answer: They help us picture something being shown clearly and in an ordered way.

questions.question: What makes the Qur’an’s explanation of the universe especially powerful?
questions.answer: It explains the universe as the Maker Himself would explain what He made.

questions.question: What does the passage say many scholars have written?
questions.answer: They have written careful, detailed commentaries on the Qur’an.

questions.question: What do these writings prove about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They prove that it has countless meanings, secrets, qualities, and signs.

questions.question: How is the Risale-i Nur described in relation to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It is described as a collection whose parts each show a truth or light from the Qur’an.

questions.question: What kinds of examples from the Risale-i Nur are mentioned?
questions.answer: Examples include works about the Qur’an’s miracle, signs connected to inventions, meaningful wording, and verses giving news beyond normal human knowledge.

questions.question: What big message does the whole passage leave with the reader?
questions.answer: The Qur’an is a miracle, has no equal, and is a true word from the One who knows the unseen.

questions.question: What three questions should be asked to know the value of a speech?
questions.answer: We should ask who said it, who it is for, and what its purpose is.

questions.question: After applying those questions, what does the passage say about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an cannot be matched or equaled.

questions.question: What is special about the One who speaks the Qur’an?
questions.answer: He is the Sustainer of all worlds and the Creator of the whole universe.

questions.question: How is the Qur’an’s speech shown to be different from made-up speech?
questions.answer: It is shown as sincere and original, not copied or forced.

questions.question: Who is addressed by the Qur’an according to the passage?
questions.answer: It addresses the Messenger who represents all human beings and all creatures.

questions.question: How is this Messenger described in rank among people?
questions.answer: He is described as the most famous and honored among mankind.

questions.question: What came from the power and width of his belief?
questions.answer: Mighty Islam came from it.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an teach about human success?
questions.answer: It teaches what brings true happiness in this world and in the Hereafter.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Qur’an explains about the universe?
questions.answer: It explains the results of its creation and the divine purposes inside it.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the belief of the Messenger?
questions.answer: It describes it as the highest, widest, and carrying all the truths of Islam.

questions.question: What does it mean that the Qur’an shows the universe like a map or a house?
questions.answer: It means the Qur’an presents the universe clearly, completely, and in an understandable way.

questions.question: Why is producing something similar to the Qur’an beyond human power?
questions.answer: Because its miraculous greatness is too high for people to reach.

questions.question: What have many expert scholars done to explore the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They have written long commentaries with evidence and careful explanation.

questions.question: What areas of the Qur’an do these scholars bring out?
questions.answer: They bring out hidden meanings, deep truths, subtle details, and signs about unseen matters.

questions.question: What does each part of the Risale-i Nur do, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Each part shows and proves one truth, light, or special feature of the Qur’an.

questions.question: What is the final proof given by all this scholarship?
questions.answer: It is that the Qur’an is without equal, miraculous, and the true word from the Knower of the unseen.
